description_en: Queries information about prefix lists associated with an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表绑定的前缀列表的信息
name: ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transit router route table
parameters.name: transit_router_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the prefix list
parameters.name: prefix_list_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the prefix list belongs
parameters.help_zh: 前缀列表所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: owner_uid

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list to query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的列表的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the next hop connection.

To query information about a prefix list that generates blackhole routes, set this parameter to BlackHole
parameters.help_zh:
下一跳连接ID。

如果您需要查询生成黑洞路由的前缀列表的信息，本参数需输入BlackHole
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en:
The next hop type. Valid values:

BlackHole: queries information about prefix lists that generate blackhole routes.
VPC: queries information about prefix lists whose next hop is a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) connection.
VBR: queries information about prefix lists whose next hop is a Virtual Border Router (VBR) connection.
TR: queries information about prefix lists whose next hop is an inter-region connection
parameters.help_zh:
下一跳类型。取值：

BlackHole：表示查询生成黑洞路由的前缀列表的信息。
VPC：表示查询下一跳为专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接的前缀列表的信息。
VBR：表示查询下一跳为边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）连接的前缀列表的信息。
TR：表示查询下一跳为跨地域连接的前缀列表的信息
parameters.name: next_hop_type

parameters.help_en: The network instance ID associated with the next hop connection
parameters.help_zh: 下一跳连接关联的网络实例ID
parameters.name: next_hop_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the prefix list.

Active: active.
Updating: being updated
parameters.help_zh:
前缀列表的状态。

Active：已生效。
Updating：更新中
parameters.name: status

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

PrefixLists.description_en: The information about the prefix lists

items.description_en: The information about the prefix lists

NextHop.description_en:
The ID of the next hop connection.

If the value is BlackHole, all CIDR blocks in the prefix list are blackhole routes, and all traffic destined for the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is dropped
NextHop.description_zh:
下一跳连接ID。

如果返回值为BlackHole，则表示前缀列表下的所有网段均为黑洞路由，所有去往前缀列表下网段的流量均会被丢弃

NextHopInstanceId.description_en: The network instance ID associated with the next hop connection
NextHopInstanceId.description_zh: 下一跳连接关联的网络实例ID

NextHopType.description_en:
The next hop type.

BlackHole: the CIDR blocks in the prefix list are blackhole routes, and all traffic destined for the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is dropped.
VPC: the next hop of the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) connection.
VBR: the next hop of the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is a Virtual Border Router (VBR) connection.
TR: the next hop of the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is an inter-region connection
NextHopType.description_zh:
下一跳类型。

BlackHole：表示前缀列表下的网段均为黑洞路由，所有去往前缀列表下网段的流量均会被丢弃。
VPC：表示前缀列表下网段的下一跳为专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接。
VBR：表示前缀列表下网段的下一跳为边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）连接。
TR：表示前缀列表下网段的下一跳为跨地域连接

OwnerUid.description_zh: 前缀列表所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

Active: active.

前缀列表的状态。

Updating：更新中

TransitRouterTableId.description_en: The ID of the transit router route table

TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的列表总条目数
